Class GroundMissileLauncher

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.SlimefunItem
      • me.kaiyan.missilewarfare.blocks.GroundMissileLauncher

    public class GroundMissileLauncher
extends io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.SlimefunItem
    A Slimefun block that serves as a ground-to-ground missile launcher, allowing players to set coordinates and fire missiles via dispensers.
